user.title: Connect your Tuya Cloud project
user.description: Enter the Tuya Cloud project credentials once. Eshtaya IR Climate will search for compatible IR air-conditioner controllers.

devices.title: Select IR air conditioners
devices.description: Only devices exposing a compatible IR climate datapoint schema are shown. You can select more than one device.

manual.title: Enter Device ID manually
manual.description: Tuya accepted your credentials but did not allow automatic device discovery, or no compatible device was found. Enter the Device ID of an IR A/C controller.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Tuya or access the requested device.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Tuya Cloud credentials, data center, or authorization.
error.not_supported: This device does not expose a compatible IR climate control schema.
error.select_device: Select at least one compatible device.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya Cloud project is already configured.
